items.title: morganlinton/BeautifulRust
items.why: Combines AI assistance with best practices for learning to program in Rust.
items.summary: BeautifulRust is a Claude Code extension that guides the AI coding agent to output high-quality, idiomatic Rust code.

items.title: dominikmartn/harp
items.why: This tool helps you manage multiple AI coding assistants simultaneously in a single interface.
items.summary: Harp is an open-source sidebar application designed to run and organize multiple Claude Code and Codex agents at once.

items.title: wesbos/3d-model-anything
items.why: A great project example combining web graphics libraries like Three.js with phone hardware.
items.summary: An open-source project that converts iPhone photo and LiDAR data into interactive, editable 3D web environments.

items.title: colinhacks/reylo
items.why: Useful if you are learning TypeScript and database integration without heavy boilerplate code.
items.summary: Reylo is an open-source library that allows developers to import SQL files directly into TypeScript with type safety.

items.title: Local Wikipedia: Wikipedia, but only for things a half hour walk from you
items.why: An inspiring, beginner-friendly project showing how open data can create practical local tools.
items.summary: A web application that filters Wikipedia to present articles about locations within walking distance of the user.

items.title: torrentplayer/torrentplayer
items.why: An interesting open-source application showcasing peer-to-peer desktop media streaming.
items.summary: TorrentPlayer is a free desktop app that lets users stream video and audio directly from torrent files.

items.title: xevrion/hatchzip
items.why: A useful utility showing how to build clean, efficient open-source cross-platform desktop software.
items.summary: HatchZip is an open-source tool that extracts zip and rar archives directly in place without copying files first.

items.title: AI use leads UC Berkeley math professor to see 'no point' in grading homework
items.why: Relevant to your student journey as AI tools transform how computer science and math are taught.
items.summary: A UC Berkeley professor stopped grading math homework after widespread AI tool adoption made traditional grading ineffective.

items.title: OpenAI and Anthropic cut their LLM prices by up to 80% within a few months. Why?
items.why: Understanding LLM price drops helps you track the decreasing cost of building AI applications.
items.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic have slashed their API pricing by up to 80 percent, making frontier AI models much cheaper to build with.

items.title: A 10-year-old CNN outperforms frontier LLMs for skin cancer diagnosis
items.why: It shows how specialized traditional machine learning models can outperform general LLMs for specific tasks.
items.summary: A decade-old convolutional neural network proved more accurate at detecting skin cancer than modern frontier language models.

items.title: Cerebras Deploys Trillion-Parameter AI Models
items.why: Keeps you updated on hardware developments that allow massive AI models to run faster.
items.summary: Cerebras deployed specialized hardware systems capable of executing trillion-parameter AI models at high speed.

items.title: We should be more ambitious with the software we build
items.why: Provides inspiring perspective on software engineering mindset for new computer science students.
items.summary: An essay encouraging developers to build more ambitious, high-quality software systems.

items.title: America has lost 200k of jobs in media, film and the arts. How much is AI?
items.why: This discussion gives insight into how AI automation is affecting real-world creative and tech job markets.
items.summary: A discussion exploring the extent to which AI adoption is responsible for recent job cuts across media and arts industries.

items.title: Musk says SpaceX restricted Ukraine's Starlink connection as service restored
items.why: Important global news about technology infrastructure and geopolitical policy.
